headline: Egypt announces discovery of 200 billion cubic feet of natural gas
summary: Egypt has announced a new natural gas discovery in the Mediterranean estimated at 200 billion cubic feet. Authorities plan to connect the field to existing pipelines to accelerate production.
why: New energy discoveries are vital for Egypt's efforts to become a regional energy hub and improve its trade balance.

impacts.name: Egypt
impacts.why: Increased domestic gas production can improve the national trade balance and energy security.
